text:
Sammy Cho: hey everyone! just finished onboarding — hi :wave: i'm sammy (they/them). i ride my skateboard to work, so wondering where's the best spot to stash it during the day? also big fan of bagels. :skateboard: :baguette_bread:
Mira Sato: welcome sammy!! :confetti_ball: there’s a rack by the courtyard stairs, but tbh people usually tuck boards under the standing lockers on 3. keep an eye on it though.
People Ops: @Sammy Cho welcome!! your badge should be active now. desk is set up on Floor 3, area B. if you have any equipment requests reply here or DM me.
Sammy Cho: awesome thanks!! can you drop the desk #?
People Ops: Desk 3B-17. also pinging @Onboard Bot to confirm swag pickup time.
Onboard Bot: hi @Sammy Cho — swag pickup scheduled today at 4:30pm by reception. bring your badge.
Alex Jensen: welcome! lunch crew heads out around 12:15, we do a weekly rotation — today is ramen / bento run. wanna join?
Sammy Cho: yes please ramen 100% :ramen:
Talia Bhat: welcome sammy!! if you want a low-key intro, there's a rooftop coffee at 10 tomorrow. also curious what skateboard model — pics? :camera_with_flash:
Sammy Cho: will post a terrible action shot in a sec. it's an old Powell-Peralta cruiser.
Noel Gomez: hi sammy, FYI someone once labeled a board "property of ops" and it was immediately adopted by the office goose. proceed with caution :duck: :joy:
Mira Sato: lol. also pro tip — leave a helmet in your locker, we have a peg that’s great for helmets.
Sammy Cho: thanks all! quick q for People Ops — where do I sign up for snack allergies / coffee preferences?
People Ops: we have a short form: https://intranet.redwood/ops/snack-preferences 
fill that and we'll update the kitchen notes.
Alex Jensen: add 'extra hot' for coffee, sammy.
Sammy Cho: done — form submitted. also, who should i bother about a second monitor?
People Ops: Ops will coordinate monitors this week; if urgent DM me and we'll expedite.
Mira Sato: welcome again. see you around 4:30 for swag pickup and tomorrow on the rooftop if you make it. :wave: :thumbsup:
